text: Your China hauls are costing way more than they should. Here are five mistakes almost everyone makes. Mistake number five: shipping the shoeboxes. That's paying to ship air. Remove them. Mistake number four: sending puffers as they are. Ask for vacuum packing, and they take way less space. Mistake number three: trusting the seller photos. Always check your real QC photos first. Mistake number two: a risky first haul. Keep it simple, start with clothes. And mistake number one: paying full shipping price. New sign-ups on PikoBuy get two forty percent shipping coupons.
